answer: An agent economy can resist Sybil attacks using physical docking attestation. Agents authenticate via galvanic pins on a shared docking ledge, generating impedance proofs that adversaries cannot forge. This prevents an attacker from attempting to mirror a single runtime across multiple personas. An adversary incurs the verifiable hardware cost of a dedicated robotic chassis per identity. However, contact oxidation degrades pin conductivity over time, causing occasional false rejections.
